jobs.location: Amsterdam, Netherlands; Berlin, Czech Republic; Remote - Europe
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

At Nebius, we’re building a next-generation AI compute platform for large-scale ML training and inference — from a few nodes to thousands of GPUs.
We’re looking for a Technical Product Manager to own product direction for Soperator — our Slurm-on-Kubernetes control plane for GPU clusters.
In this role, you will shape how ML engineers and research teams run, scale, and optimize distributed workloads in production.
If you care about systems that combine performance, reliability, and developer experience at the frontier of AI infrastructure, this role is for you.

Your responsibilities will include: 

• Own the full user journey across Soperator clusters: Slurm workflows, dashboards, alerts/notifications, node lifecycle, and training/inference capacity management.
• Define product direction end-to-end: problem discovery → solution design → delivery → adoption.
• Lead deep customer discovery through interviews, usage analytics, and workload analysis to uncover high-impact opportunities.
• Drive execution across platform teams: compute, networking, storage, observability, IAM and etc.
• Translate frontier ML and infrastructure ideas into practical product capabilities for real-world GPU clusters.
• Define success metrics, prioritize roadmap decisions with data, and ensure measurable customer/business impact.
• Lead the open-source strategy and execution for Soperator: shape public roadmap themes, prioritize OSS-facing capabilities, and ensure strong adoption in the community.  

We expect you to have: 

• 3–5+ years in Product Management, ML infrastructure/MLOps, distributed systems, or cloud platform engineering.
• Strong technical depth in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or ML platforms.
• Hands-on familiarity with large-scale ML training and orchestration tools (e.g., Slurm, Kubernetes, Ray).
• Track record of shipping technically complex products with multiple engineering teams.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management across engineering, research, and customers.
• Experience with product analytics, data-informed prioritization, and experimentation.
• High ownership, high learning velocity, and comfort operating in fast-moving AI infrastructure environments.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

• Experience with GPU platforms and HPC primitives: InfiniBand/RDMA, topology-aware scheduling, high-throughput storage.
• Practical understanding of modern ML training stacks: PyTorch, DeepSpeed, FSDP/ZeRO, NCCL.
• Familiarity with efficiency and reliability metrics: Goodput, MFU, failure modes, preemption handling, health checks.
• Exposure to large-scale LLM training/inference systems.
• Experience in observability, performance tuning, or SRE/reliability engineering.
• Customer-facing technical experience (solutioning, support, architecture advisory).

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Lead complex digital transformations for some of the world's most recognized brands.

Have you ever wondered what it takes to deliver highly technical software implementations at enterprise scale? Join our Professional Services team and help customers unlock the full potential of Coveo's AI-powered platform.

With more than 1,000 implementations delivered over the years for global organizations such as Dell, Rolex, and Salesforce, our team tackles complex technical challenges every day. You'll play a key role in aligning business objectives, technical requirements, and project execution to ensure successful customer outcomes.

As one of our Technical Project Managers, you will:

  • Lead the implementation of Coveo's platform by defining project scope, objectives, milestones, and success criteria.
  • Act as the primary delivery lead and trusted advisor for customer stakeholders, driving alignment, decision-making, and accountability throughout the implementation lifecycle.
  • Coordinate customer stakeholders, internal experts, and project resources while managing expectations throughout the engagement.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, proactively tracking budgets, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Manage project changes, assess impacts, and implement mitigation strategies to minimize delays and risks.
  • Communicate project progress regularly to customers and internal stakeholders through status reports, governance meetings, and executive updates.
  • Identify, assess, document, mitigate, and escalate risks when required to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Partner closely with architects, developers, and technical customer stakeholders to translate business requirements into user stories and implementation decisions that maximize customer value.

Here is what will qualify you for the role:

  • At least 7 years of experience gathering requirements, producing technical documentation, and coordinating quality assurance activities.
  • At least 3 years of experience managing large-scale information technology implementation projects.
  • Strong understanding of the technical challenges associated with implementing cloud-based software solutions and web applications.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, leadership, organizational, and communication skills in complex customer-facing environments.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively with developers, architects, business stakeholders, and executive sponsors.

What will make you stand out:

  • Experience with Agile delivery methodologies and tools such as Jira and Azure DevOps.
  • Project management certifications such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Scrum Master, or equivalent.
  • Experience with web development or software engineering.
  • Knowledge of enterprise search, indexing technologies, Salesforce ecosystems, or professional services automation tools such as Certinia (formerly FinancialForce) or Mavenlink.
  • Experience working in a consulting, professional services, or customer implementation environment.

This role requires strong English communication skills, as you will work primarily with English-speaking customers and stakeholders across North America and global markets.

Do you think you can bring this role to life? Send us your application, we want to hear from you!

Join the Coveolife!

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of, for example, age, gender, disability, gaps in CV, national or ethnic background.

jobs.title: Tech Product Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir verwandeln bedeutende Momente in wunderschöne Erinnerungen. 
 celebrate ist eine Markengruppe mit der Mission in ganz Europa schöne Momente in bleibende Erinnerungen zu verwandeln: mit hochwertigen Papierwaren, Fotoprodukten und besonderen Geschenkartikeln.
 Wir suchen einen Tech Product Manager (m/w/d) für unser Platform-Team, der Struktur, Klarheit und Dynamik in unsere Plattformstrategie bringt – in einer Phase tiefgreifender Transformation. Du verantwortest die Platform-Roadmap, koordinierst über Engineering-, Produkt- und Vendor-Teams hinweg und stellst sicher, dass die Plattform als echter Beschleuniger für unsere Marken funktioniert. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CTO und arbeitest in einem hybriden Setup mit hoher Eigenverantwortung.
 Die Gehaltsspanne für diese Position liegt bei 70.100€ bis 94.800€ brutto pro Jahr (Senior).
 Deine Rolle 
 Ownership der Platform-Roadmap inklusive Backlog-Priorisierung, Sequenzierung und Dependency-Mapping – mit dem Ziel, langfristige Plattformgesundheit und kurzfristige Lieferfähigkeit in Balance zu halten

 Cross-Team-Koordination über Platform Engineering, Produktteams und externe Vendor (z. B. CommerceTools, PIMCore) hinweg, um Initiativen abzustimmen, die mehrere Domänen betreffen

 Technische Spezifikation und Entscheidungsfindung durch Requirements-Dokumente, RFC-/ADR-Prozesse und Vendor-Evaluierungen – mit dem Anspruch, Dokumentation aktuell zu halten und Agentic-Style-Engineering zu ermöglichen

 Vermittlung des Mehrwerts der Plattformarbeit für Stakeholder durch die Übersetzung von technischem Fortschritt, Entscheidungen und Trade-offs in klare, nachvollziehbare Business Outcomes

 Deine Benefits 
 Wir schätzen Flexibilität: Flexible Remote-Arbeit, Teilzeitoptionen, moderne Hardware (Macbooks), kollaborative Büroflächen (Flex Desks)

 Wir begrüßen New Work: Agile Arbeitsweise, Fair Pay, Kompetenz- und Führungsmodelle

 Wir möchten, dass es dir gut geht: Nilo.health, Corporate Benefits, JobRad, Workations, Sabbaticals, 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub sowie dein persönliches Benefit nach Wahl: Wellpass, Hansefit oder das DB-Jobticket.

 Wir wollen mit dir wachsen: Interne Weiterbildung, Coaching, regelmäßige Feedback- und Wachstumsprozesse, flexible externe Lernmöglichkeiten

 Wir sind ein Team: Office-Frühstück und Lunch, (freiwillige) Events, Remote Team-Building, Office Dogs, und exklusive Family & Friends-Rabatte

 
 Dein Profil 
 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung als Technical Product Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise in komplexen Multi-Brand- oder Multi-Plattform-Umgebungen

 Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im technischen Schreiben und in der Dokumentation, einschließlich Architekturübersichten, Integrationsguides, ADRs und API-Dokumentation

 Fließendes Englisch erforderlich; Deutschkenntnisse auf konversationellem Niveau sind ein Plus

 Dein Mindset 
 Platform as product – Du verstehst die Plattform als eigenständiges Produkt mit klarer Value Proposition, internen Nutzern (Engineering-Teams) und hohem Qualitätsanspruch.

 Documentation-as-Product – Du behandelst Dokumentation als erstklassiges Ergebnis, nicht als Nachgedanken, weil du überzeugt bist: Was nicht dokumentiert ist, ist nicht fertig.

 Ruhe in der Komplexität – Du bleibst gelassen, wenn sich Prioritäten verschieben und Systeme ineinandergreifen, und bringst Struktur in Ambiguität, ohne Prozesse zu überdesignen.

 Über celebrate company 
 celebrate company ist eine Markengruppe bestehend aus Atelier Rosemood, celebrate apps, celebrate digital printing, faireparterie, kartenmacherei und mintkind. Zusammen umfassen wir E-Commerce-Shops, Produktionsstätten sowie weitere digitale Services, die sich darauf fokussieren innerhalb von Europa, schöne Momente in bleibende Erinnerungen zu verwandeln. Als New-Work-Pioniere haben wir eine Organisation geschaffen, in der der Mensch im Mittelpunkt steht und die auf Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und Flexibilität basiert.

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager - B2B SaaS (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bei epilot gestaltest du direkt mit, wie über 200 Energieunternehmen ihre Produkte digitalisieren – von der Netzanschluss-Anfrage, über die Photovoltaikanlage bis hin zum Stromtarif. Wir suchen einen Product Manager mit echtem Product Mindset und dem Hunger, etwas aufzubauen – ob du dich "Senior" nennst oder nicht, ist uns dabei egal. Was zählt: wie du denkst, wie du entscheidest und wie ambitioniert du an deine Arbeit herangehst. Du verantwortest einen zentralen Produktbereich, arbeitest eng mit Engineering und Design zusammen und bringst datengetriebene Entscheidungen auf die Roadmap. Kein Konzernumfeld, kein endloser Abstimmungsmarathon – sondern echter Gestaltungsraum in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden SaaS-Scale-Ups der Energiewirtschaft.
 
 epilot digitalisiert die Energiewirtschaft mit einer einzigartigen Cloud-Software. Wir sind ein wachsendes Scale-Up im Herzen von Köln. Unsere Mission: epilot revolutioniert die Zusammenarbeit aller Marktpartner, die in der Energiewelt zur Erbringung von Produkten und Dienstleistungen zusammenarbeiten. Wir bieten innerhalb der Cloudwelt ein großes Netzwerk aus Partnern, welches durch die Community ständig erweitert wird.
 
 Das erwartet dich 
 Verantwortung deines Produktbereichs von der Strategie bis zur Auslieferung – mit voller Ownership über Discovery, Roadmap und Ergebnis.

 Du arbeitest täglich eng mit einem cross-funktionalen Team aus Engineers und Designern zusammen und schaffst klare Prioritäten.

 Übersetzung von Kunden-Feedback, Marktanalysen und Business-Ziele in konkrete Features – und du weißt, wann du etwas weglassen musst.

 Du nutzt deine starken analytischen Fähigkeiten und dein tiefes Verständnis für unsere Kund:innen, um unser Produkt im Markt strategisch auszurichten und zu differenzieren.

 Du triffst smarte Entscheidungen basierend auf der Auswertung von KPI’s, sowie Kunden- und Marktanalysen.

 Hands-on im Code: Kleine PRs, Konfigurationsänderungen oder das direkte Testen im Code sind für dich kein Tabu – du verstehst, was unter der Haube passiert, und das macht dich zu einem besseren PM.

 
 Das bringst du mit 
 Du denkst wie ein Entrepreneur – du verstehst unsere Business-Ziele und wie deine täglichen Entscheidungen diese beeinflussen.

 Nachweisbare Erfolge: Features oder Produkte, die du von der Idee bis zum Launch verantwortet hast und auf deren Wirkung du stolz bist.

 Kommunikationsstärke gegenüber verschiedenen Stakeholdern: u.a. Engineers, Sales, Geschäftsführung & Kund:innen.

 Auf sich ändernde Bedingungen und Anforderungen reagierst du schnell, hast eine starke Do-it Mentalität und bist ein Mensch, der Unkonventionelles mag.

 Deine kreative Denkweise ermöglicht es dir, innovative Lösungen für komplexe Probleme zu finden und Features zu konzipieren, die im Markt gebraucht werden.

 Du bist ein TEAM-Player, motivierst und begeisterst deine Leute, um gemeinsam die gesetzten Ziele zu erreichen.

 AI-Tools nutzt du aktiv in deiner täglichen Arbeit – sei es für Research, Prototyping, Datenanalyse oder das Schärfen von Anforderungen – und weißt, wie du sie sinnvoll in den PM-Prozess integrierst.

 Du hast Erfahrungen mit den gängigen Tools des digitalen Projekt- und Produktmanagements, z.B. Jira, Figma, Miro, Power-BI o.ä. und agile Arbeitsweisen (Scrum/Kanban) liegen dir.

 Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Sprache und Schrift.

 Ein Produkt mit echtem Impact: Unsere Plattform beschleunigt die Energiewende – du siehst, wofür du arbeitest.

 Start-up-Mentalität: dynamische Atmosphäre und großartiger Teamspirit.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Local Payments
jobs.description:
At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.

Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.

 
 

 

 The Purpose: 
 

 
 As a Product Manager in PPRO’s Local Payments Domain, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the payment experiences for our customers and partners, ensuring seamless, compliant, and efficient access to local payment methods. You will drive product discovery and delivery, working at the intersection of Engineering, Marketing, Risk, and Commercial teams to enable seamless adoption of local payment methods to some of the world’s leading fintechs, PSPs, and merchants. 

 Product Managers at PPRO have the passion and abilities for ensuring that we focus our time and energy on building the right things for our customers. You will inform the strategy, communicate with all relevant stakeholders and lead effective product discoveries with your team. Our mission is to make local payment methods as ubiquitous and accessible as credit cards. You will own and develop a portfolio of Local Payments integrations, engaging with schemes, defining a strong value proposition, and validating and setting success metrics. 

 In this impactful and highly visible role, you will own key business opportunities and product initiatives related to the portfolio, orchestrating flows, fine tuning the user experience, and co-creating new features together with the schemes and our customers. Your work will directly impact PPRO’s ability to scale globally by increasing adoption, improving success rates, and driving the commercial and technical integration of high-value local payment products. 

 What You Will Be Doing 
 
 
 
 Execute and inform our product strategy for our local payments portfolio from scheme engagement to product feature development and market launch. 

 
 Drive product discovery and delivery - collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to develop innovative, "Better-than-direct" payment experiences that drive value for our business and customers. 

 
 Develop and optimise the payments product portfolio that balances scheme requirements, financial efficiency, and high success rates for consumers and merchants. 

 
 Work hands-on with data - analyze key business opportunities and success metrics related to payment acceptance rates, scheme performance, and financial flow efficiency to drive meaningful outcomes. 

 
 Define clear success metrics and KPIs to measure payment method efficiency, automate reporting, and enable data-driven decision-making. 

 
 Collaborate cross-functionally – work closely with Compliance, Risk, Sales, and Customer Success teams to refine payment requirements, implement new features, and understand business needs. 

 
 Inform the roadmap planning and lead the execution for key initiatives, such as the strategic integration of new local payment methods, optimization of existing flows, and co-creation of new products with schemes. 

 
 Be a thought leader in local payments – stay ahead of regulatory changes, market trends, and best practices to keep PPRO at the forefront of effective, efficient, and accessible payments across the world. 

 

 What Success Looks Like 
 
 
 
 Improved adoption and financial performance of the local payments portfolio through optimization and strategic feature releases. 

 
 Higher payment success rates and fewer manual interventions for payment flows. 

 
 Seamless integration and expansion of new local payment methods and features into the core PPRO platform, replacing legacy integration methods. 

 
 Clear, data-driven insights into payment performance (acceptance rates, authorization rates, scheme metrics), with real-time visibility for internal stakeholders. 

 
 Positive feedback from customers and partners on the functionality, reliability, and value derived from the local payment methods. 

 

 What We Are Looking For 

 
 Product Leadership: Proven experience owning a product or feature set, leading product discovery, and executing successfully in a fast-paced environment. 

 
 Strong Analytical Mindset: Ability to work with data, define KPIs, and drive decisions based on insights rather than intuition.

You translate a deeply technical product into narratives that win deals, arm Sales with competitive intelligence and enablement assets, and partner with Product and Engineering on go-to-market. This is a hands-on role in a small, senior marketing team alongside Growth, GTM Ops, and Design.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Fintech/Insurance)
jobs.description:
At TechBiz Global, we are providing recruitment service to our TOP clients from our portfolio. We are currently seeking an Senior Product Manager specialist to join one of our clients ' teams. If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to grow in a innovative environment, this could be the perfect fit for you.

 Tasks

 As a Senior Product Manager you will be responsible for the success of client’s product from start to finish. Specifically, this means:

 -Strategy & Roadmap: You develop a clear vision, translate company goals into tangible product objectives, and maintain a prioritized roadmap.

 -Backlog & Planning: You write clear user stories, ensure the backlog remains organized, and make sure everything aligns with sprint and quarterly goals.

 -Discovery & Validation: You conduct structured discovery, evaluate ideas and solutions, and derive decisions from them.

 -Delivery & Quality: You work closely with Engineering and QA to ensure features are launched on time and with high quality – including test cases and release notes.

 -Metrics & Impact: You define success criteria, track usage and performance, and optimize them based on measurable results.

 -Stakeholder Alignment: You communicate priorities, compromises, and progress clearly and transparently to Business, Operations, and Leadership.

 -User Focus: You incorporate the user's voice into all decisions.

 -Leadership & Collaboration: You ensure close collaboration between developers, QA, design, and business stakeholders so everyone knows what matters and who is responsible for what.

 -Platform Team: You shape client’s platform and process topics—from custom workflows and task management to notifications and permissions—and ensure they are specifically tailored to the requirements of insurers and MGAs.

 Requirements

 WHAT YOU BRING

 Experience: At least 8 years of professional experience in product management. Ideally in the insurance, finance, or workflow sectors (e.g., Camunda, Celonis, n8n, etc.).

 End-to-End Product Ownership: Proven experience managing the product lifecycle from discovery to market launch and in continuous improvement through data-driven methods.

 Agile Methods: Solid knowledge of agile frameworks (Scrum/Kanban), backlog management, and requirements engineering.

 Analytical Skills: Ability to translate complex business and technical problems into clear, actionable requirements.

 Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German (C1 level).

 Tools: Practical experience with common project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Figma, analytics tools, API documentation platforms).

 Problem Solving: You thrive in complex situations, consciously and thoughtfully compromise, and drive coordination, keeping stakeholders informed as needed.

 Collaboration: Proven ability to work closely with engineering, QA, design, and operations teams to deliver value incrementally and iteratively.

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir haben uns zum Ziel gesetzt, die komplexen Herausforderungen und Chancen der digitalen Zukunft für unsere Umwelt positiv zu gestalten. Unsere Spezialisierung liegt in der Verbesserung der Softwareentwicklungs- und Bereitstellungsprozesse unserer Kund:innen mit dem Ziel, die digitale Souveränität insbesondere im Public Sector zu stärken. Wir beraten auf Augenhöhe, entwickeln uns immer weiter und bleiben dabei offen für alles: neue Tools und Trends, neue Arbeitsformen, neue Menschen .

 Für unsere Mitarbeitenden haben wir ein transparentes und offenes Arbeitsumfeld geschaffen, das Innovation, Effizienz und Zufriedenheit in den Vordergrund stellt.

 Wenn du auch einen positiven Einfluss auf die digitale Zukunft ausüben möchtest, sind wir dein space to be. 

 Aufgaben

 WAS DU BEI UNS VERANTWORTEN KANNST 

 Du identifizierst Kundenbedürfnisse zielgerichtet, denkst lösungsorientiert und liebst es, technische Anforderungen auf den Punkt zu bringen? Dann werde Teil unseres agilen Teams und sorge dafür, dass aus Ideen smarte Softwarelösungen entstehen. Dabei übernimmst du folgende Aufgaben:

 
 Du verantwortest das technische Anforderungsmanagement für ein GitOps-Tool im Behördenumfeld

 Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für die externen und internen Kund:innen des Entwicklungsteams und übersetzt deren Anforderungen

 Du formulierst und priorisierst technische Konzepte, Epics und User Stories mit dem Entwicklungsteam

 Du koordinierst die operative Arbeit des Developer-Teams mit einem Scrum Master und behältst Qualität, Budget und Fortschritt im Blick

 Du unterstützt die Head of Product in fachlich-strategischen Themen

 Du präsentierst Produktlösungen verständlich für technische und nicht-technische Stakeholder wie z.B. Kunden

 
 Qualifikation

 DEINE SKILLS 

 Du bringst eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, ein Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit, verfügst über exzellente Deutschkenntnisse (C2) und fühlst dich im direkten Kundenkontakt wohl. Diese Erfahrungen erleichtern dir den Einstieg:

 
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung als DevOps- oder Cloud-Engineer

 Erfahrung im technischen Requirements Engineering oder als (technischer) Product Owner in einem agilen Umfeld

 Ein gutes technisches Verständnis von Containerisierung und Softwareentwicklung (SDLC, CI/CD, Architektur)

 Erfahrung im Umgang mit Kennzahlen (z. B. DORA-Metriken, KPIs) und Projektmanagement

 Kommunikationsstärke, Moderationstalent und die Fähigkeit, technische Inhalte verständlich zu vermitteln

 
 DEINE PERSPEKTIVEN 

 Bei Cloudogu arbeitest du an technologisch relevanten Themen rund um Open Source, Cloud-native Technologien und digitaler Souveränität. Dabei übernimmst du früh Verantwortung und gestaltest die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kund:innen, Produktmanagement und Entwicklung aktiv mit.

 Die Rolle bietet dir die Option, dich zur/zum Product Owner weiterzuentwickeln. Gleichzeitig arbeitest du in einem Umfeld, das pragmatische Lösungen, Eigenverantwortung und moderne Zusammenarbeit fördert.

 Wenn du gerne Menschen, Technik und Projekte zusammenbringst und spürbaren Impact schaffen möchtest, dann ist Cloudogu dein space to be.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - House Owner & Service Request Acquisition (all genders)
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

 We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and grow the top of our marketplace funnel.

 Aroundhome is a two-sided marketplace platform where the possibility of shared success begins with the match: the moment a homeowner is connected with the right partner. The House Owner & Service Request Acquisition domain owns everything upstream of that match. It starts when a homeowner discovers Aroundhome through search or content, continues as they describe their home project, and ends when a qualified service request is handed to matching. The quality of that request shapes the experience on both sides of the marketplace, so acquisition volume, conversion, and data quality are all part of your responsibility.

 At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping the success of Germany's leading housing project platform. We work in a domain-based model, where each product team owns a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration within cross-functional teams and ensures that the expertise for continuous product discovery, hypothesis development, and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.

 As a Senior Product Manager, you drive and execute the strategy, set a clear direction, and make sure your domain delivers meaningful value to both customer groups, homeowners and partners, as well as to the business.

 
 You continuously shape domain strategy and vision, setting clear measurable goals and a roadmap for homeowner acquisition: steering the full acquisition mix across paid and unpaid channels with a clear focus on growing the organic share, improving conversion along the homeowner journey, and raising the quality of the service requests handed to matching. You actively rally those around you toward this vision.

 You grow sustainable, unpaid acquisition through SEO, AI search optimization and scalable acquisition systems that compound over time, while keeping paid channels an effective and efficient part of the mix. You design and read high-traffic conversion experiments to lift conversion and data quality.

 You are responsible for building a robust architecture and foundation that supports our acquisition experience. You ensure our setup is scalable and ready for automated qualification, enabling seamless processes that benefit the entire marketplace.

 You identify where AI genuinely improves the homeowner experience and the platform's qualification processes, and you bring those opportunities into production together with Engineering, from first prompt experiments to shipped, measurable features.

 You drive domain growth through continuous end-to-end product discovery, using qualitative insights (interviews, usability tests, feedback, NPS) and quantitative data to identify opportunities and make evidence-based, outcome-driven decisions with measurable impact.

 You communicate with clarity and purpose, translate complex system and data topics into compelling narratives, and foster strong collaboration across Product, Tech, Product Analytics, UX, SEO and Content, Sales, and cross-domain stakeholders. You help carry the shift from a sales-driven organization toward a product platform.

 You ensure a strong balance between long-term strategic goals and short-term trade-offs, driving continuous lean delivery through effective backlog management and close collaboration with Engineering and Design.

 
 Skills

 
 You have hands-on experience building organic acquisition and understand SEO fundamentals (topical authority, local SEO, structured data, page performance) as well as how AI-driven search and assistants are changing discovery (AEO), ideally within a marketplace or high-volume consumer platform.

 You are experienced in optimizing complex user funnels and conversion flows, using experimentation (A/B testing) and data to improve conversion, quality, and user trust while laying the foundation for long-term platform engagement.

 You apply strong analytical thinking and product analytics skills to define success measures, interpret data, uncover insights, and guide evidence-based decisions that improve homeowner and business outcomes.

 You bring a strong technical affinity to help shape our underlying acquisition and conversion architecture. You understand the concepts of data models or taxonomies and have enough grasp of APIs and data flows to reason about feasibility and sequencing with engineers.

 You work with LLMs as a natural part of your daily practice and can show concretely how they strengthen your discovery, analysis, and delivery. Ideally, you have taken AI beyond personal productivity and understand how scalable AI solutions reach production-grade features, for example through prompt chains, LLM-supported data extraction, or automated qualification flows.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager, Delivery (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Associate Product Delivery Manager to help turn product priorities into clear, well-organized work for our engineering and design teams.

 Working closely with our Product Lead, you will help define new features, prepare upcoming work, coordinate requirements, and keep track of sprint progress. You will bring structure and clarity to the product-development process while growing your product-management skills through hands-on experience and mentorship.

 This is a good opportunity for someone early in their product career who is organized, curious, and comfortable collaborating across different disciplines.

 Tasks

 
 Draft feature scopes, requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria with guidance from the Product Lead.

 Help maintain and organize the product backlog.

 Prepare features and tasks for refinement and sprint planning.

 Coordinate requirements and open questions between product, engineering, and design.

 Track sprint status, delivery progress, dependencies, and blockers.

 Keep the team and relevant stakeholders informed about progress and changes.

 Support planning, refinement, reviews, and other product-delivery meetings.

 Document product requirements, decisions, and changes.

 Gather the information needed for prioritization discussions.

 Contribute recommendations while the Product Lead retains final prioritization responsibility.

 Help improve the team’s product-development and delivery processes.

 Take on greater product ownership as your skills and experience develop.

 
 Requirements

 What we’re looking for 

 
 Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in product management, project coordination, business analysis, software delivery, design, QA, or a related area. Relevant internships and working-student experience may count.

 Some experience working with software engineering, design, or other multidisciplinary teams.

 The ability to turn discussions and ideas into clear written requirements and action items.

 Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

 Clear and thoughtful written and verbal communication.

 Confidence following up on open questions, dependencies, and commitments.

 Curiosity about users, technology, and how digital products are built.

 A collaborative mindset and willingness to ask questions and learn.

 Basic familiarity with agile product development and tools such as Jira, Linear, Notion, or Confluence.

 
 Helpful, but not required 

 
 Experience writing user stories or acceptance criteria.

 Familiarity with sprint planning, backlog refinement, or software-release processes.

 Enough technical curiosity to learn about APIs, data flows, system dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.

 Experience working in a startup, scale-up, or another quickly changing environment.

 
 You do not need to meet every item on this list. We care about your potential, judgment, communication skills, and willingness to learn.

 What success looks like within your first six months: 

 
 Upcoming features and tasks are documented clearly and prepared on time.

 Sprint progress, dependencies, and blockers are visible to the team.

 Product decisions and requirement changes are consistently documented.

 Engineering and design know where to find the information they need.

 Open questions are identified and brought to the right people early.

 The Product Lead has reliable support across planning, prioritization, and delivery.

 You begin handling smaller features with increasing independence.

 
 Benefits

 We offer an exciting environment at the interface between IT and entertainment and marketing as part of an ambitious, international and results-orientated team in a young startup.

 
 You work with an excellent international team with varied tasks with a wide range of great opportunities

 An attractive and competitive salary

 Monthly learning budget

 Urban Sports Club membership support

 Support for your favourite means of transport - we help finance your new bike or your public transport subscription

 We are a startup in one of the cultural hubs in Berlin, you'll never get bored
